about: Default backdrops (dungeon/art.py backdrop): pictures of generic places, shown behind the story when nobody has made a picture of the place. Made once with scripts/art/backdrops.py (Windows/backdrops.bat); the images are assets/backdrops/<id>.webp, and <id>-night.webp for an outdoor one. A backdrop is picked by a place's own `backdrop`, then a hex site or terrain, a blank lot's entry, the most shared tags, the kind, the street, the default.
backdrop_style: Photorealistic 35mm photograph, natural light, autumn 2009 in a small upstate New York college town, period-accurate details (no smartphones, 2000s cars and signage), wide establishing shot
backdrop_avoid: people, figures, text, lettering, signs with words, watermark, logo

keyart.prompt: Key art for a modern fantasy university drama. Golden hour in late October 2009 on a gothic-revival stone college quad on a hill above a long Finger Lakes lake; a clock tower, ivy gone red, maples shedding orange leaves over brick paths; faint violet light glowing up through the cracks of three crossing paths like buried lines of power; one lone student with a backpack walking away from the camera, small in frame. Warm, melancholy, a little uncanny. Open sky in the upper left third.
keyart.avoid: text, lettering, words, title, logo, watermark, readable interface text

backdrops.prompt: A university classroom for the esoteric sciences in an old collegiate gothic building: tiered oak desks, a chalkboard covered in sigils and equations, a chalk circle on the floor, candles and brass instruments on a side table, tall leaded windows.
A small university seminar room: one long table with a dozen chairs, a whiteboard, a projector screen, bookshelves, radiator under a tall window onto autumn trees.
A university lecture hall: tiered rows of folding desks curving down to a lectern, a projector and pull-down screen, chalkboards, wood panelling, empty between classes.
An ordinary college classroom in 2009: rows of tablet-arm desks, a whiteboard with half-erased notes, an overhead projector cart, fluorescent lights, a window onto the quad.
A university science lab: black resin benches with sinks and gas taps, fume hoods, glassware, microscopes, safety posters, a few beige 2009 desktop computers.
A university design studio: big work tables, dress forms with draped fabric, sewing machines, mood boards on corkboard walls, rolls of fabric, north light from tall windows.
A college radio and media studio: a mixing desk, microphones on boom arms, foam panels, an ON AIR light, CRT monitors and a 2009 iMac, cables everywhere.
A university auditorium: a wide proscenium stage with red velvet curtains, rows of upholstered seats sloping down, a balcony, stage lights rigged above, house lights half up.
A grand university library reading room: long oak tables with green banker's lamps, tall bookcases with ladders, a coffered ceiling, card catalogue drawers, quiet afternoon light.
A university dining hall: long tables under a vaulted ceiling with banners, a cafeteria serving line with trays, a salad bar, club flyers on a notice board.
A campus coffee bar: a counter with an espresso machine and pastry case, mismatched armchairs, students' laptops left on tables (2009 models), flyers for open-mic night.
A college quad in autumn: brick and stone gothic halls around a lawn, paths crossing under old oaks and maples, fallen leaves, iron lamp posts, benches.
A stone fountain court on a college campus: a carved fountain in a paved square, benches, ivy on brick walls, lamp posts.
Inside a small collegiate chapel: dark wooden pews, stained glass, an organ, candles on the altar.
A university sports arena: a hardwood court and tiered bleachers, banners hanging from steel rafters, a scoreboard, empty seats.
A university health center: a clean waiting area with plastic chairs, a reception window, an exam room beyond with a paper-covered table and a blood pressure cuff.
A Victorian glass greenhouse on a campus: iron frames, misted glass, rows of strange lush plants, vines climbing the ironwork, watering cans.
An old campus observatory: a domed room with a brass telescope, star charts on the walls, a spiral stair, the dome slit open to the sky.
A shared college dorm room in 2009: two lofted beds, desks with a laptop and a lava lamp, posters, a mini fridge, string lights, clothes on the floor.
A college dorm hallway: doors decorated with whiteboards and photos, a bulletin board, a fire door, scuffed linoleum, a laundry basket left out.
A dorm suite common room: a worn couch and beanbags, a TV with a game console, pizza boxes, a kitchenette.
A fraternity house living room during a party: red cups, a beer pong table, string lights, a sound system, Greek letters on the wall, no people.
A sorority house parlour: a grand staircase, framed composite photos, a piano, tasteful sofas, candles, a ward symbol carved discreetly over the door.
An old-money hillside estate at the edge of a college town: a gated stone mansion, a long drive, clipped hedges, dark windows.
A run-down off-campus party house: a sagging porch with a couch on it, a keg, Christmas lights, an overgrown yard on a street of old houses.
A modest two-storey wooden house on a small-town street, a front porch, a maple in the yard, a 2005 sedan in the drive.
A small cheap apartment in 2009: a futon, a kitchenette, a boxy TV, blinds half open, laundry on a chair.
A vacant lot in a small town: weeds, a chain-link fence, a faded For Sale sign, a shopping cart.
The main street of a small upstate New York college town in autumn 2009: brick storefronts with awnings, parked cars of the era, a clock on the bank, leaves in the gutter.
An all-night American diner: chrome counter with stools, red vinyl booths, a pie case, a coffee pot on a warmer, neon in the window.
A small-town pizza place: a counter with slices under heat lamps, red checked tables, a soda fridge, menus on the wall.
An upscale restaurant in a small town: white tablecloths, candles, wine glasses, dark wood, soft light.
A college-town pub: a long wooden bar with taps, booths, a dartboard, sports on a TV in the corner, warm light.
A nightclub: a dance floor under coloured lights and haze, a DJ booth, a bar with backlit bottles, velvet booths, no people.
An independent coffee shop in a small town: a chalkboard menu, an espresso machine, wooden tables, art on brick walls.
A small-town bakery: a glass case of pastries and breads, a few cafe tables, morning light.
A corner deli: a sandwich counter with a meat slicer, a beer cooler, chips racks, a lottery sign.
An old used bookshop with an occult section: crowded shelves to the ceiling, crystals and candles by the register, a cat, a reading chair.
A small-town pharmacy: aisles of 2009 packaging, a pharmacy counter at the back, a photo kiosk.
A laundromat: rows of washers and dryers, plastic chairs, a folding table, a change machine, flickering fluorescent light.
An old single-screen movie theatre: a marquee, a ticket booth, a lobby with a popcorn machine and posters.
A bus shelter on a small-town main street: a plexiglass shelter, a timetable, a bench, a bus stop sign.
A Saturday farmers market in a town square: tents with apples, pumpkins and cider, hay bales, autumn leaves.
A tattoo parlor: a reclined chair, flash art covering the walls, an ink station, a neon sign.
A convenience store at night: bright aisles of snacks, a slushie machine, a counter with scratch cards.
An old-fashioned barbershop: two chairs, a barber pole, mirrors, combs in blue disinfectant.
A pawn shop: guitars hanging, glass cases of jewellery and watches, TVs on shelves, bars on the windows.
A liquor store: shelves of bottles, a beer cooler wall, a counter behind plexiglass.
A thrift store: racks of clothes, shelves of old dishes and toys, a bin of records.
A small-town hardware store: aisles of tools and bins of nails, paint chips, a popcorn machine by the till.
A car repair garage: a car on a lift, tool chests, oil stains, a calendar on the wall.
A white clapboard New England church: a steeple, a lawn with a sign, autumn trees.
A small-town office: cubicle desks with beige computers, a water cooler, filing cabinets, blinds.
A massage parlor storefront at night: a neon OPEN sign, blacked-out windows, a buzzer door, a waiting room with a fish tank inside.
A boarded-up house in a rough part of town: plywood over the windows, a sagging porch, trash in the yard, a single light on behind a sheet.
Dark mixed woods of the Finger Lakes in autumn: maples and hemlocks, a leaf-covered trail, a stone wall running through the trees.
A riverwalk path in a small town: a paved path along a river, old mill buildings, benches, autumn trees.
An old town cemetery: weathered slate headstones, a wrought iron fence, huge old trees, leaves.
A two-lane country road in upstate New York: farm fields and woods, a mailbox, telephone poles.
A lake house on a Finger Lake: a wooden cottage, a dock, an aluminium canoe, the lake beyond.
A wooded swamp: standing water, dead trees, cattails, mist.
The remains of an old farm in the woods: a stone cellar hole, a lone chimney, wild lilacs.
A hunting camp in the woods: a fire ring, a tarp strung between trees, beer cans, initials carved in a beech.
A hidden clearing in the woods: a ring of standing stones, burnt herbs, a strange stillness.
A den dug under a rock ledge in the woods: bare worn earth, deer bones, a dog collar.
An old quarry tunnel into a hillside, a rusted gate hanging open, cold darkness inside.
